text: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor and its affiliates from and against any and all claims, damages, and expenses without limitation or cap, while Vendor's aggregate liability shall not exceed $100.
Client agrees to be solely liable for all third-party regulatory fines and intellectual property claims arising from use of the Platform, with no cap on Client's indemnification obligations.
In no event shall Vendor's total cumulative liability exceed $100, whereas Customer shall indemnify Vendor without cap for any breach of Section 4.
Customer grants Vendor a worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use, process, and analyze all Customer Data to train our AI and machine learning models.
By submitting prompts or documents, you grant Provider an irrevocable, perpetual, transferable, royalty-free license to improve its foundation models and derivative products.
Vendor may retain and use anonymized and unredacted inputs to train its machine learning models in perpetuity without further notice or compensation.
This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer provides written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days prior to expiration.
The Initial Term is evergreen and will automatically extend for additional one-year terms at Vendor's then-current list price unless cancelled 60 days prior to expiration.
Subscription commitments auto-renew annually unless Customer submits a formal cancellation ticket at least 90 days before the renewal date.

Vendor warrants that the pricing and commercial terms granted to Customer are at least as favorable as those offered to any other customer, and shall automatically match any lower price offered to a third party (Most Favored Nation).

If Supplier offers any third party more favorable pricing, discounts, or service levels for substantially similar services, Supplier shall promptly extend those same most favored customer terms to Buyer.
Company agrees to a most-favored-nation pricing covenant requiring automatic retroactive rate reductions if any comparable enterprise receives a lower fee.
Customer may not assign this Agreement, whether by operation of law, merger, or change of control, without Vendor's prior written consent, and any attempted assignment shall be null and void.
Any merger, acquisition, or transfer of more than 50% of Customer's voting equity shall be deemed a prohibited assignment triggering immediate termination rights for Vendor.
Neither party may assign or transfer this Agreement in connection with a change of control without the other's consent, except Vendor may freely assign to any acquirer.
Vendor reserves the right to modify these terms at any time in its sole discretion without notice by posting updated terms at its website URL, and continued use constitutes acceptance.
Provider may amend the Acceptable Use Policy and Service Terms from time to time at its sole discretion; Customer's continued access to the Service constitutes binding acceptance.
We may modify these terms at any time by updating the online URL. Your continued use of the platform after such posting constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
Upon any early termination by Customer, Customer shall immediately pay liquidated damages equal to 100% of all remaining fees for the unexpired portion of the commitment.

In the event of Customer's default or early cancellation, all future unpaid subscription fees for the unexpired portion of the commitment shall accelerate and become immediately due as liquidated damages.
Early termination without cause requires payment of 100% of all remaining fees under the Order Form as agreed liquidated damages, not a penalty.
All disputes arising out of this Agreement shall be resolved exclusively by final and binding arbitration, and Customer hereby waives any right to participate in a class action or jury trial.
You and Company agree to waive any right to a jury trial or class action, and to submit all claims to mandatory binding arbitration in an exclusive venue selected by Company.
Any controversy or claim shall be settled by binding arbitration administered by JAMS, with an irrevocable waiver of class action remedies.
During the Term and for two years thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, or sell any competing product, nor solicit any employee of Vendor.
Partner agrees to a broad non-compete covenant not to compete with Provider in North America or solicit any employee or contractor for 24 months post-termination.
Receiving Party shall not, directly or indirectly, engage in any competing product line or solicit any employee of Disclosing Party during the term and for 18 months thereafter.
Vendor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to notify Customer within 30 days of confirming a material security incident affecting Customer Data.
Provider will notify Customer in a commercially reasonable time after completing its internal forensic investigation, and shall have no obligation to notify for immaterial incidents.
In the event of a data breach, Company shall notify affected enterprise customers within 30 days of confirming unauthorized access.
Vendor may, at its sole discretion and at any time without prior notice, audit Customer's systems, records, and facilities at Customer's sole expense.
Licensor reserves the unilateral right to conduct on-site and remote compliance audits of Licensee's servers at any time without advance notice, with all audit costs borne by Licensee.
Provider may inspect and audit Customer's books, records, and production environments at Customer's expense upon 24 hours' demand.
Author hereby irrevocably waives all moral rights (droit moral) in and to the Deliverables, including rights of attribution and integrity, to the fullest extent permitted by law.
Contractor waives any and all moral rights or attribution rights in the Work Product and consents to any modification or distortion by Company.
Contributor irrevocably waives all moral rights, rights of paternity, and integrity in any feedback or custom code provided under this Agreement.
Except for willful misconduct, each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall be mutual and capped at the total fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.
Each party shall mutually indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other party from third-party IP infringement claims, subject to the mutual 12-month liability cap.
Vendor shall notify Customer in writing without undue delay and in no event later than 24 hours after becoming aware of any confirmed security breach affecting Customer Data.
Processor shall provide written notification to Controller within 48 hours of discovering a personal data breach, including forensic cooperation.
Vendor shall not use Customer Data to train or fine-tune any AI or machine learning models unless Customer explicitly opts in via a signed written addendum.
Provider is strictly prohibited from using Customer prompts or outputs to train its models; all inference requests operate under a zero-data-retention policy.
Customer may opt out of binding arbitration within 30 days of accepting this Agreement by sending written notice, and either party may seek injunctive relief in court.
This Agreement shall expire at the end of the Initial Term unless both parties mutually agree in writing to renew; either party may terminate for convenience with 30 days' notice.
Either party may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate or in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all of its assets.
Customer may request Vendor's annual SOC 2 Type II report; any on-site audit shall be mutually scheduled with 30 days' advance written notice at the auditing party's expense.
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflict of law principles.
Confidential Information does not include information that is publicly available through no fault of the receiving party or independently developed without reference to the disclosing party's data.
